primitives.note: Deathbringer Stance arms Aatrox's next basic attack to deal bonus magic damage equal to a level-scaled % of the target's max health, applies life steal.
Landing a basic attack (on-hit) or an ability on an enemy champion reduces Deathbringer Stance's current cooldown by 2s, doubled to 4s if the hit was The Darkin Blade's sweetspot.

Q: three sequential casts (1s static gap, 4s window to continue) each dealing separate damage before going on cooldown. W: an initial hit plus, if the tether survives 1.5s, a second identical-timing pull-damage instance.
Each subsequent Q cast (2nd, 3rd) deals 25% more base+AD damage than the previous cast, multiplicatively stacked with the sweetspot multiplier.
Whether each Q cast lands its Sweetspot (75% bonus damage + knockup) against a stationary dummy depends on hitbox geometry that must be assumed for the fight.
Umbral Dash resets Aatrox's basic attack timer and can be cast without interrupting other abilities, letting an extra auto be weaved into the rotation.
World Ender grants 20-40% bonus AD for its (extendable) 10s duration, amplifying all of Aatrox's AD-scaling damage sources.

Umbral Dash's passive heal (16% + 1.1%/100 bonus HP of post-mitigation non-persistent champion damage) and World Ender's self-healing amplification (50-100%) only change Aatrox's effective damage taken/survivability, never damage dealt.

needsBespoke.why: Every mechanic that changes damage dealt or taken (Deathbringer Stance's empowered auto and its on-hit cooldown refund, Q's three-part ramping/sweetspot strikes, W's two-timed hits, E's attack-reset and self-heal, R's AD buff and healing amp) is expressible as a combination of listed primitives; nothing requires bespoke logic beyond composing them.

unsettled.question: Is Deathbringer Stance's empowered basic attack already available at the start of the 15s damage fight, or does it need to charge from a fresh/uncharged state (10-22s depending on level)?
options: Assume it is pre-charged and ready at t=0
Assume it starts uncharged and must recharge from the level-based cooldown before Aatrox's first empowered auto

unsettled.question: Does a stationary target dummy get hit by The Darkin Blade's Sweetspot on every one of Aatrox's three Q casts (since the sweetspot is a separate farther/inner hitbox layered on the main AoE), or should only the non-sweetspot (center) damage be assumed?
options: Assume every Q cast lands its Sweetspot (max damage, knockup, and doubled Deathbringer Stance CDR)
Assume Q lands only its base (non-sweetspot) damage each cast
quotes: As implied by the previous point, the {{as|Sweetspot}} for the first and second cast is implemented as separate [[area of effect|areas of effect]] to the main component of the ability.

unsettled.question: For Infernal Chains' delayed pull hit against a champion, is the total damage dealt across both hits the sum shown in the wiki's 'Total Damage' leveling row (2x base + 80% AD, matching the minion-doubled formula), or does each hit (initial and delayed) independently deal only the single-hit value (base + 40% AD), with the doubled row belonging solely to the minion-damage tooltip?
options: Second hit equals the first hit (base+40% AD each, summing to 2x base+80% AD total) as literally stated ('the same physical damage again')
The wiki's 'Total Damage' row (2x base, 80% AD) is itself the value of the delayed hit alone, on top of a separate initial hit, roughly doubling total W damage again
quotes: If the tether is not broken by the end of its duration, the target is dealt the same {{as|physical damage}} again and {{tip|airborne|pulled}} to the center of the area.

unsettled.question: Does each of Q's three separate strikes (and W's two hits) independently trigger Deathbringer Stance's on-hit cooldown reduction every time it connects, letting a single Q combo refund up to 12s of DBS cooldown, or is the refund capped/deduplicated per ability activation window?
options: Each landed strike/cast independently refunds 2s (4s on sweetspot), stacking across all 3 Q casts and both W hits
The cooldown reduction is capped or only applies once per ability use regardless of how many enemies/strikes it hits
quotes: Each cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

proposal: Open by casting World Ender (R) immediately to secure its 20-40% bonus AD (and healing amp) for the rest of the fight, since it has only one use in a 15s window.
If Deathbringer Stance is already charged, land the empowered basic attack first for its large flat magic-damage burst and life steal.

Cast The Darkin Blade (Q) and chain all three casts back-to-back (respecting the 1s static gap and 4s recast window), aiming every strike to land its Sweetspot for maximum ramping damage and the biggest Deathbringer Stance cooldown refunds.
Cast Infernal Chains (W) on cooldown between Q combos, holding the tether uninterrupted so it deals its delayed second hit.
Weave basic attacks into every gap, using the Deathbringer Stance empowered auto the instant it comes off cooldown from the accumulated on-hit/on-ability refunds.
Use Umbral Dash (E) purely as an attack-reset whenever it is off cooldown right after landing an auto, to squeeze in extra basic attacks rather than for its (irrelevant, no-damage) mobility.
Repeat the Q three-cast combo and W cast on cooldown for the remainder of the 15s, prioritizing Q's ramping/sweetspot damage over auto-attacks when both are available.
questions: Is Deathbringer Stance assumed pre-charged at the start of the damage fight, and does its bin-defined charge-up curve (AatroxPassive#PCooldown, 22 to 10s by level) actually gate the very first empowered attack if not?

Against a stationary dummy that 'counts as an enemy champion,' is it realistic/intended for every Q cast to land its Sweetspot given the described hitbox geometry (point-blank rectangle/trapezoid edge vs a ground-targeted circle)?

Is there a hard lockout window after each Q cast during which Aatrox cannot auto-attack (the wiki notes a bug to this effect), and if so how long, since it affects how many autos can be woven into the 15s rotation?

Does casting R before Q/W actually apply its bonus AD to those abilities' 'current stats' damage calculation at the moment they land, confirming R should be cast first rather than last for maximum total damage?
